profile.headline: Software Engineer at Quanata, a State Farm company
profile.summary:
Software engineer with experience writing distributed applications and RESTful APIs and scaling up systems using Golang, Python, and C++. 

GitHub: https://github.com/cachecoww

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid
positions.description:
Enterprise Connectivity Team - working primarily in GoLang, C++, and Python 
Identity Team - Python

positions.title: Open Source Contributer
positions.description:
Contributed to large cloud native distributed systems runtime framework
GitHub: https://github.com/cachecoww

positions.title: Manufacturing Technician
positions.description: I work closely with a team of engineers and technicians to operate, maintain, and improve semiconductor etch equipment using Statistical Process Control (SPC) and other data analysis techniques. Currently collaborating with dispatch GUI engineers to improve readability of lot dispatch GUI. I am also an active member of the safety committee.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: I assisted a graduate student by performing experiments on cancer cells. I utilized techniques such as cell culture and Western Blot and performed data analysis using Excel and OriginLab. I also helped optimize the experimental conditions.

positions.title: Undergraduate REU in Renewable Energy
positions.description: I participated in the 2016 UW-Madison Renewable Energy Research Experience for Undergraduates, where I got to investigate catalysts for renewable fuel production. I synthesized several catalysts using incipient wetness impregnation and ran the reactions using a continuous flow reactor. I used Gas Chromatography (GC) and Excel to analyze the product distribution.  I presented the poster at the 2017 ERN (Emerging Researchers) Conference and placed first in Chemical Sciences division. The abstract from this research is available below.

volunteerExperiences.description: Led a team of a dozen people in planning events for over 300 incoming freshmen

projects.title: Cow Breed Identifier Android App
projects.description: Independent project that involved creating an Android App that identifies Cow breeds from pictures using Java programming and AutoML Vision REST API.

projects.title: Squidward Chatbot
projects.description: Created a chatbot written in Python that impersonates Squidward from Spongebob TV show. Compiled and parsed transcripts using Python and trained recurrent neural network models using Pytorch on AWS/EC2. Integrated model into Flask application.

publications.title: Overcoming resistance to targeted anticancer therapies through small-molecule MEK degradation

organizations.description: Attend weekly meetings to practice public speaking
